summary.text: Cathy White, a Working Class Party candidate who says she has worked for 40 years as a factory production worker, lost the November 3, 2026 election for governor of Maryland to Wes Moore.
The party won 2026 ballot status by submitting over 12,000 signatures.

paragraphs.text: White was the Working Class Party's nominee for lieutenant governor in 2022.
In 2026 she was the party's candidate for governor, with Cathy Permut as her candidate for lieutenant governor.
She received 1.9% of the vote to Wes Moore's 64.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
